entwurf.thema: ElevenLabs Dubbing: Translate Video with Original Voice
entwurf.beschreibung: Learn how ElevenLabs’ Dubbing tool turns a YouTube clip into a foreign‑language version while preserving the speaker’s voice. Follow three clear steps, see the cost, and understand the limits.

teile.name: Hook
teile.text: Open ElevenLabs, select Dubbing from the menu.
teile.szene: A frustrated creator staring at a stack of script pages, bright studio light, 2024 modern office, central crop on face.

teile.name: Step 1
teile.text: Upload a video or paste a YouTube link.
teile.szene: Hands dropping a laptop into a digital drop zone, soft neon glow, 2024 tech vibe, central vertical crop.

teile.name: Step 2
teile.text: Choose a target language and adjust speaker similarity.
teile.szene: Screen showing language dropdown, slider at 7, finger pressing green button, warm desk light, 2024 UI aesthetic.

teile.name: Step 3
teile.text: The app shows the cost in credits before confirming.
teile.szene: Progress bar filling, credits counter ticking, evening office lamp, central crop on monitor.

teile.name: Payoff
teile.text: Confirm to generate the dub; it will be watermarked free.
teile.szene: Happy creator watching dubbed video on a tablet, sunrise window, 2024 cozy office.

teile.name: CTA
teile.text: When ready, download the dub from your list.
teile.szene: Animated hand tapping a like button, bright comic pop‑art style, 2024 game‑poster vibe.

teile.name: Limitation
teile.text: Like, share, and save your new localized video.
teile.szene: Warning sign on a clipboard, muted office light, 2024 realistic illustration.
